feed.title: FMIQ Nexus Status
feed.subtitle: Incidents and planned maintenance for FMIQ Nexus

entry.title: Planned maintenance: Database upgrade
entry.content:
Scheduled. Window: Sun 18 Oct 2026, 10:00 pm AEDT to Mon 19 Oct 2026, 12:00 am AEDT.
We are upgrading the FMIQ Nexus database to a newer version. The app will be unavailable for up to two hours during this window. Work saved on the mobile app will sync once the work is complete.

entry.title: Identified: Slow sign in and data loading
entry.content:
We have found the cause, a slow database query after this morning's release. A fix is being applied now.
Estimated restore time: Tue 13 Oct 2026, 3:30 pm AEDT

entry.title: Incident: Slow sign in and data loading
entry.content:
Investigating. Estimated restore time: Tue 13 Oct 2026, 3:30 pm AEDT.
Some customers may see slow sign in and delays when loading work orders. Your data is safe. We are investigating.

entry.title: Monitoring: FMIQ Nexus app unavailable
entry.content: Service restored at Sat 10 Oct 2026, 8:48 am AEDT. Monitoring.

entry.title: Incident: FMIQ Nexus app unavailable
entry.content:
Investigating. Estimated restore time: not yet known.
We are aware that FMIQ Nexus is not responding and are investigating. Updates will follow here.

entry.title: Completed: Platform security updates
entry.content: The updates are complete and FMIQ Nexus is available again.

entry.content:
